data.answer: TagZ Foods was co-founded in June 2019 by Anish Basu Roy and Sagar Bhalotia in Bengaluru, India. TagZ Foods was co-founded in June 2019 by Anish Basu Roy (with 13 years in F&B) and Sagar Bhalotia in Bengaluru, India, spotting a gap for popped potato chips amid saturated fried/baked options. The idea emerged from Anish's observation of consumer demand for taste-driven, innovative snacks using cutting-edge food tech like high-pressure popping for minimal oil, blending indulgence with health (e.g., nutrition-focused labels).
